status: candidate / pending_human_review (model reading; not a gate action)
dataset_family: ADNI. ADNI-1: 419 MCI (174 MCIc / 245 MCInc). ADNI-2: 611 MCI (206 MCIc / 405 MCInc). The follow-up window that defines MCIc is not stated.
method_family: Multi-branch transformer with late fusion. Two 3D vision transformers read the CAT-12 grey- and white-matter volumes and are joined by cross-attention. A tabular transformer (ClinFormer) reads neuropsychological scores, demographics, APOE4 and six FastSurfer ROI volumes. The branch outputs are concatenated into an MLP head. 10-fold CV. The same broad family as P-81's CNN late fusion.
same_sample_or_cohort_as: P-3, P-104, P-81 (current supporters): the ADNI dataset family. ADNI-1/ADNI-2 MCI sets of this size very probably overlap P-3's ADNI1/2 sample and the others' ADNI MCI. Not checked at participant level.
ADNI candidates from rounds 1 and 2 (for example P-190, P-211, P-1128, P-731, P-532): the same dataset family.
shared_authors_with: None with P-3, P-104, P-81 or the other round-2 candidates. The authors are Shijin Knox G.U., Anurenjan Purushothaman, Pradeep R. and Sreeni K.G. (Kerala, India).
what_it_shows:
The study compares its models within itself: same 10-fold CV, same hyperparameters (batch 8, learning rate 0.0001, 32 heads). Results for ADNI-1 / ADNI-2:
- Imaging-only GrayFormer+WhiteFormer: AUC 0.8204 / 0.8687, accuracy 0.7441 / 0.8398.
- ClinFormer alone (neuropsychology, demographics, APOE4 and ROI volumes), best configuration: AUC 0.8126 / 0.8666, accuracy 0.7750 / 0.8480.
- Fused model: AUC 0.8808 / 0.9310, accuracy 0.8162 / 0.8867.
In both ADNI phases fusion adds about 0.06 AUC over the imaging-only model and 0.064-0.068 over the clinical branch. Held-out test figures (AUC 0.8718 / 0.9240) are reported for the fused model only.
why:
STATED: yes, with caveats. The study runs the comparison itself, on the same folds, in two ADNI phases.
- The fused model beats every single-branch model it ran (GM-only, WM-only, GM+WM, ClinFormer) on AUC, accuracy, recall and F1.
- The comparator closest to the P-81 failure, a multivariable clinical model, loses by 0.064-0.068 AUC in both phases.

Round-1 criteria:
- Criterion (ii) is met only in an impure form. The clinical branch also receives six MRI ROI volumes (p.3), so no purely non-imaging model was run. If the volumes help ClinFormer, this makes the comparator stronger, not weaker, but the pure arm is still missing. If the adjudicator requires a purely non-imaging arm, this verdict becomes partly.
- Criterion (iii): hyperparameters were chosen on the same CV results that are reported (p.6). The single-branch arms are reported at their best configuration, while the fused arm uses one configuration taken from them. The selection therefore favours the comparators.
- Criterion (iv): the fused model's precision is below the imaging-only model's (ADNI-1 0.8000 vs 0.8321; ADNI-2 0.8455 vs 0.8758), while its recall is higher. That is a threshold trade-off, not a reversal of discrimination.

NARROWED: yes. Adding the clinical branch to the imaging model beats the same imaging model alone: AUC 0.8204 to 0.8808 (ADNI-1) and 0.8687 to 0.9310 (ADNI-2). The added branch mixes cognitive scores, which the narrowed wording names, with MRI ROI volumes from the same scans. So the gain cannot be credited to non-imaging data alone.

CAVEATS:
(1) No test compares the fused model with the single-branch models. The Wilcoxon tests in Table 8 compare against other papers' published figures.
(2) The +/- values are implausibly small for fold-to-fold SDs. For example, accuracy +/- 0.0032 in ADNI-2 is far below one subject's share of a fold (about 0.016 at about 61 subjects per fold). The paper does not say what they measure, and they cannot show whether the gaps exceed noise.
(3) The conversion window that defines MCIc is not stated.
(4) The test split is not described, and only the fused model is reported on it.
(5) Circularity: the clinical inputs include CDR-SB, FAQ, ADAS and MMSE, which partly define conversion. SHAP ranks FAQ, ADAS13 and LDELTOTAL highest (p.7).
(6) Registry note, not acted on: the Modality 'MRI/PET' is wrong, because the paper uses no PET.

INDEPENDENCE: ADNI, so no new dataset family. The method family (transformer late fusion) is close to P-81's CNN late fusion.

quotes.quote: The ROI volumes extracted from MRI images are also fed to the text transformer as an additional feature.

The neuro-psychological data of the subjects includes Alzheimer’s Disease Assessment Scale (ADAS) [44], CDRSB [45], MMSE, LDELTOTAL [46], TRABSCOR [47], FAQ [48], APOE4, RAVLT(Rey Auditory Verbal Learning Test) scores, Gender, PTEDUCAT, Race category and Ethnic category.
ADNI-1, contains 419 subjects, including 174 MCIc subjects, 245 MCInc subjects. The second dataset, ADNI-2, contains 611 subjects, including 206 MCIc subjects, and 405 MCInc subjects.
